_readme: Ve's file: the model, turn cap, time limit, USD cap and daily cap of each kind of claude session (run-loop.ps1 starts one session per job). Edit by hand; the loop only reads it. Missing or empty values fall back to the defaults in gate-rules.ps1 ($SessionDefaults, $LoopOptionDefaults). A build uses build.smallModel when its issue carries one of build.smallLabels, else build.model. maxBudgetUsd is passed to claude as --max-budget-usd (0 = no cap); a build on a model that is not Opus uses build.smallMaxBudgetUsd. A session stopped by its USD cap mid-build is failure class max-budget (retried once, like max-turns). maxPerDay: at most this many sessions of the kind start per local day across all runs (0 = no cap; counts in <LOOP_HOME>\state\daily-sessions.json). options: proposeIssueDigest (the runner lists the issues once into the proposal header), compactPrompts (build-only LOOP.md blocks left out of proposal/review prompts), logKeepDays (prune old logs at run start; rundata.json and run-<id>.log kept; 0 = never), digestMaxIssues, digestDeployedDays. run-loop.ps1 -Model / -MaxTurns override every session for one run.
